title: Decision page: small chart library or plain SVG, accessibility and theming
goal: The owner has a page with the options and a recommendation
acceptance: docs/decisions/charts.md sets out the options: plain Angular + SVG (no dependency, as Grover's plant-chart.ts does) against a small library (named candidates with bundle size, licence, maintenance, SSR and zoneless support), with a recommendation

The page states the accessibility contract (role img with a summary, a visually hidden or toggled data table, keyboard focus on points or bars, patterns or labels so meaning is never colour alone, prefers-reduced-motion) and the theming contract (series colours and axes from bx tokens only, light and dark from the theme, no literal colours)
It lists the shared inputs (series, axis formatters, empty state, height) so the four components share one API
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One decision page; Grover's plant-chart.ts is the plain-SVG reference. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
